title: Zesty Chewy Mexican Mushroom Tacos
description: A cultured and chewy Oaxacan dish featuring Thai holy basil krapao, spherified for a unique texture, and suitable for ovo-vegetarian diets. This midnight craving dish combines Mexican and Thai flavors for a delicious and exotic taste experience.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the onion and garlic and saute until softened.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the holy basil and cook for an additional minute.
In a small bowl, mix the sodium alginate with a small amount of water to create a spherification bath.
Drop small amounts of the mushroom mixture into the spherification bath and let cook for 2-3 minutes.
Remove the spherified mushroom mixture from the bath with a slotted spoon and place on a paper towel lined plate.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a few spherified mushroom mixture pieces onto a tortilla and topping with cheese, lime juice, and any desired additional toppings.
